page.overview:
Who is Sweet Pop?

Sweet Pop is the placeholder name of a Pegasus pony filly who first appears in the season episode The Cutie Mark Chronicles. She has a pale violet coat, two-tone gray mane and tail, and spring green eyes.

Sweet Pop shares her design with "Peachy Petal", "Mango Dash", "Pinkie Feather", "Rainy Feather", S05E25 Unnamed Pegasus Filly #1, and sometimes earlier filly Derpy, her mane and tail style with Peachy Pie, and her mane style with "Purpletastic/Purpleskies".

She, along with "Tornado Bolt", Cotton Cloudy, "Princess Erroria", "Noi", Aura, and Liza Doolots and as well as Prim Posy, Lemony Gem, "Serena", "Pinkie Feather", "Rainy Feather", and "Mango Dash", was to appear in Friendship is Magic, part 2.

Sweet Pop first appears in The Cutie Mark Chronicles. She is seen in both Fluttershy and Rainbow Dash's flashbacks.
